t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The previous participant believed that by choosing some specific colour gnomes (tall purple, tall blue, short neon green and short red) at the beginning of the game yielded the highest number of mushrooms. The previous participant warned that some way through the game they switched and these high scoring gnomes were not as high scoring. The participant could not figure out after this switch which gnomes were the highest yielding. The participant wasn't 100% confident that there was a pattern to the highest yielding gnomes and suggested it could all be just random.

vb_textbox.text: It was just my experience but unfortunately I found this game to be entirely random. I think the only possible pattern I might have found was on choosing a side. Sometimes gnomes on one side seemed to better than gnomes on the other side but after a while it would switch to the gnomes on the other side being better, but I'm not at all convinced that was a real effect. I think it was just completely random.
